integrity: Full face-poset acyclicity and two independent enumerations; independent mod-two boundary ranks and signed Lefschetz traces rederived from first principles.
scientific_limitations: One finite graph only; no dihedrally equivariant sphere-wedge, integral representation splitting or antiprism family classification. Indexed originality comparisons do not exclude all unindexed work.
scientific_scope: Integral homotopy type and rational dihedral homology character of the perfect-matching complex of the twelve-vertex hexagonal-antiprism graph.
title: A nineteen-sphere perfect-matching complex on the hexagonal antiprism
